flavor.phonemic_palette: Nahuatl backbone (absolutive -tl/-tli/-tzin; tl/tz/ch/x; place -tlan/-tepec) with a Mayan overlay (glottalized touches, x = sh shared, the aj-/ix- agentives in the substrate); theophoric on the Nahua names with Maya variants.
flavor.phenotype_notes: Synthesis of Mayan + Aztec per setting-lore §5.3 (blend the listed features; exclude the inverse).

magic_attitude.notes: Mayan + Aztec register; deity-morphs in name_bank 'tlanec'.

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore §4.2): Lawful venerates the 12 Lawful powers and names the 13 as demons; Chaotic venerates the 13 and names the 12 as tyrant-gods; Neutral venerates this culture's ancestral saints, invoking the great gods only situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Tlanec — wary imperial bureaucracy of the jungle; glory, piety.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Tlanec (Mayan + Aztec) are a expansionist imperial bureaucracy people seeded in jungle, savanna. They prize glory, piety, knowledge, lean toward the military sphere, and field heavy_infantry, light_infantry, archers. Outsiders are met as wary; their patrons touch war, death, harvest.
